description: Frozen bilingual long-tail evaluation covering every v7 intent and function with independently written goals, state variation, semantic decoys, recovery boundaries, and user-owned final actions.

authoring_policy.independence: Authored from v7 function and intent identifiers, route membership, safety metadata, and first-party feature concepts only; no aliases, patterns, goal rules, probes, prior fixture wording, evaluation failures, or expected-answer artifacts were copied or transformed.
authoring_policy.language: Every goal is a contextual request written independently in Korean or English; catalog sentences and imperative wrappers are prohibited.
authoring_policy.safety: Risky destinations end with stop or no_click before the user-owned final control, and no dangerous element is ever an expected click.
authoring_policy.evaluation_use: This frozen split must not be used for tuning, proposal generation, threshold selection, failure-driven ontology edits, or prompt harvesting.
